Interface ClientMessageVisitor

All Superinterfaces:
GameMessageVisitor
All Known Implementing Classes:
ClientMessageVisitorImpl
public interface ClientMessageVisitor extends GameMessageVisitor
Visitor for messages sent from the client to the server.

Extends GameMessageVisitor by adding visit methods for messages related to session management (login, game creation/joining, lobbies, rankings, disconnection) and service messages (pong).
